question: What do ERC-4626, 7540, 7575, 6909 and 3009 specify, and which of them can Tidepool rely on today?

findings.finding: Status Final, created 2021-12-22, requires 20 and 2612. The standard fixes asset, totalAssets, convertToShares, convertToAssets, preview and max functions, deposit, mint, withdraw and redeem.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: description: Tokenized Vaults with a single underlying EIP-20 token.

findings.finding: Rounding rule for the two convert functions.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: To ensure consistency across all EIP-4626 Vault implementations it is specified that these functions MUST both always round _down_.

findings.finding: Status Final, created 2023-10-18, requires 20, 165, 4626 and 7575. A vault implements asynchronous deposit, asynchronous redemption or both, through request, pending, claimable and claim states with an operator model.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: MUST implement one or both of asynchronous deposit and redemption Request flows.

findings.finding: Preview functions of the asynchronous flow must revert; the claim is separate from the request.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: previewDeposit and previewMint MUST revert for all callers and inputs.
All asynchronous Vaults MUST return the constant value true if either 0xe3bc4e65 ... or 0x2f0a18c5 ... is passed through the interfaceID argument.

findings.finding: Status Final, created 2023-12-11. A vault exposes share(), the address of an ERC-20 share token that can be a separate contract from the vault, so several vaults can mint one share token. Vault ERC-165 id 0x2f0a18c5; share token id 0xf815c03d.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: The address of the underlying share received on deposit into the Vault. MUST return an address of an ERC-20 share representation of the Vault.

findings.finding: Status Final, created 2023-04-19, requires 165. Interface: transfer(receiver,id,amount), approve(spender,id,amount), setOperator(spender,approved), per-id balances and allowances in one contract; operators are not subject to allowance limits.

Status Draft, created 2020-09-28, requires 20 and 712. Functions transferWithAuthorization, receiveWithAuthorization and cancelAuthorization move a token on a signed authorization with a nonce and validity window, so a third party can submit the transaction.

variables.q: production vaults implementing ERC-7540 on Base with verified address

searches.reading: The ERC-7540 text names no production implementations and the reference repository (erc4626-alliance/erc-7540-reference, last commit 2024-08-21) is a reference implementation. No Base address of a 7540 vault was read in this pass, so none is claimed.

variables.q: USDC transferWithAuthorization on Base read with cast

searches.reading: USDC on Base reports version "2" in the Base yield-venues read; the ERC-3009 selectors were not called, so support is not claimed from this read.
